description: Defines the CapturedTouchpadEventConverter class for processing touchpad input events in Android, including methods for event processing, state management, and motion range population.

classes.name: CapturedTouchpadEventConverter
classes.description: A class for converting and processing touchpad input events, managing motion ranges, and maintaining input state.

methods.name: CapturedTouchpadEventConverter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the converter with input context, device info, and motion accumulator.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current state for debugging.

methods.name: populateMotionRanges
methods.description: Populates motion range information for the input device.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state of the converter.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a raw input event and returns a list of notification arguments.

methods.name: tryAddRawMotionRange
methods.description: Attempts to add a motion range for a specific axis.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes input state at a given timestamp.

methods.name: makeMotionArgs
methods.description: Creates motion argument objects for input events.

methods.name: makePointerCoordsForSlot
methods.description: Generates pointer coordinates for a specific slot.

methods.name: allocatePointerIdToSlot
methods.description: Allocates a pointer ID for a given slot number.

methods.name: freePointerIdForSlot
methods.description: Frees the pointer ID associated with a slot number.
